announcements.title: Diwali Special Dinner 🪔
announcements.body: This Friday dinner is a full festive spread — kaju katli, paneer tikka, dal makhani, and live jalebi counter. Dress code: ethnic. Mess closes at 22:00 instead of 21:30.

announcements.title: Mess fee due by the 10th
announcements.body: Semester mess dues must be cleared by the 10th of this month. Late fee of ₹50/day applies after that. Pay via the student portal.

announcements.title: New: rotating check-in code
announcements.body: Attendance is now marked with the 6-character code on the screen at the mess entrance. It rotates every 30 seconds, so no proxies 👀
